Chapter 10. Bringing It All Together—a Roadmap for Lasting Team Success
Let’s be honest—moving from dysfunction to a truly cohesive team isn’t something that happens overnight. It’s an ongoing journey, and it asks a lot from every one of us. We need to be intentional, have a bit of courage, and sometimes step right into discomfort, all for the sake of something bigger than just our own success.
When teams work through those five big barriers—building trust, engaging in healthy conflict, committing to decisions, holding each other accountable, and focusing on collective results—that’s when the magic really happens. That’s when a team can unlock its full potential.
So, how do you put these ideas into action? Well, here’s a simple roadmap any team can follow:
First, assess where you are right now. Maybe it’s a quick survey or just an honest conversation. Which roadblocks are you running into most? Is it trust? Accountability? Pinpoint it together.
Next, focus on one thing at a time. Start with the basics—the foundational layers—before you try to fix everything else. You can’t build a house on shaky ground, right?
Then, create some shared rituals. Maybe it’s a weekly check-in, open feedback sessions, or just regular moments to reflect as a group. These little habits reinforce trust, keep communication honest, and make accountability part of your team’s DNA.
And don’t forget to celebrate your progress, even if it feels small. Every step forward matters. Recognizing those wins builds momentum and gives everyone a boost of confidence.
Sure, this process isn’t always easy. But the rewards? They’re absolutely worth it. Teams that stick with it find more satisfaction in their work, build stronger relationships, and see better results together. They’re more flexible, creative, and able to bounce back when things get tough.
Remember, the five dysfunctions framework isn’t some quick fix. It’s a guide you can return to, again and again, as your team grows. By coming back to these principles, your team can handle new challenges, grab new opportunities, and create success that lasts.
That’s the real power of working together on purpose.
